sources.inflation: World Bank/FRED annual CPI inflation for 2019-2024; 2025 provisional from IMF/WEO-style published estimate; CPI index reconstructed with 2018=100.
sources.current_cpi: Trading Economics/CAPMAS/CBE reported CPI points, April 2026 used as current CPI reference.
sources.gold_price_egp: 2018-2025 external reconstructed from DataHub/World Bank Commodity Markets annual gold USD/oz × official USD/EGP average / 31.1035; current from Sabika manual app reference.
sources.silver_price_egp: 2018-2025 external reconstructed from published annual silver USD/oz × official USD/EGP average / 31.1035; current silver not used in v1.
sources.usd_egp: World Bank official exchange rate annual average where available; 2025 from CEIC/World Bank GEM published annual average.
sources.bank_certificate: Representative NBE/Banque Misr public certificate rates by year; requires final business/source review before public launch.
sources.cbe_rate_sanity_check: CBE historical interest-rate data used internally as a reasonableness check, not customer-facing.

methodology.inflation: Reconstructed CPI index with 2018=100 using annual consumer-price inflation rates. This is an index value, not an annual inflation percentage.
methodology.gold_price: Before Sabika historical prices are available, gold is calculated as external reconstructed reference price: annual gold USD/oz × annual average USD/EGP ÷ 31.1035. Current gold uses Sabika manual reference.
methodology.silver_price: Before Sabika historical prices are available, silver is calculated as external reconstructed reference price: annual silver USD/oz × annual average USD/EGP ÷ 31.1035. Silver is future-ready and optional in v1 unless enabled in UI.
methodology.bank_certificate: Representative EGP certificate path based on notable NBE/Banque Misr certificates, annualized, assuming yearly reinvestment. certificate_rate is decimal, e.g. 0.18 = 18%.
methodology.source_labeling: external_reconstructed prices must be displayed as reference prices, not Sabika execution prices.

notes: Do not present external_reconstructed years as Sabika execution prices.
Do not promise future gold/silver returns.
Gold path is active in v1. Silver data is included as future-ready; do not block v1 if silver path is disabled.
Certificate rates for 2018-2022 should be audited against archived NBE/Banque Misr pages before final paid launch.
